waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Naturkartan says Sjuhäradsleden as a whole is not fully quality-assured by Västkuststiftelsen, and STF warns some reroutes may not be updated. Västsverige says stages 3-7 are quality-assured.
Naturkartan GPX ends at and joins section 4 around [57.732252, 12.798760], while Borås/SOK-stugan coordinate and OSM relation endpoint sit about 190-200 m west near the clubhouse/access cluster.

Official route-line start at IK Omega aligns with section 2 and GPX, while Omegastugan/Start etapp 3 access coordinate is about 1.15 km south and is where parking/info and Bråtes bro bus access are described.

OSM relation 4176438 has correct from/to tags but reverse/awkward member order, one 51.5 m continuity gap after reorientation, and an endpoint near SOK-stugan clubhouse rather than Naturkartan's section-continuity endpoint.
Hultafors shelter evidence is strong, but OSM/Vindskyddskartan indicate a new shelter and an old poor-condition shelter at the same cluster.
Older/local pages mention Sandevi or Backabo, while current Västtrafik/GTFS checks support Skogshill övre as the practical nearest stop.

facilities.name: Hultafors Vindskydd / Stora utsikten / Viaredssjön rest area
facilities.description: Main stage rest area and viewpoint above Viaredssjön. Official PDF calls it 'Vindskydd med utsikt' and says there is a fireplace, compost toilet and waste bin. Västsverige highlights it as Stora utsikten. Vindskyddskartan/OSM indicate a new shelter/fireplace built in November 2024 while an older shelter remains in poor condition. Model as a cluster because there may be both old and new shelters. Do not treat water as potable.
